facts.fact: Studies cited by the page show pages with rich snippets can see an 82% higher click-through rate compared to pages without them.
facts.quote: Studies have shown that pages with these rich snippets can see an **82% higher click-through rate** compared to those without.

facts.fact: Per Schema.org data cited by the page, as of 2024 only about 12.4% of all domains use any form of structured data.
facts.quote: Data from Schema.org shows that as of 2024, only about **12.4% of all domains** are using any form of structured data.

facts.fact: The page states that Google officially recommends JSON-LD as the format for adding schema markup.
facts.quote: This is the format Google officially recommends because it's so efficient and flexible.

facts.fact: The page states that local schema markup is not a direct ranking factor in the traditional sense, though its effect on user engagement can indirectly help rankings.
facts.quote: Local schema isn't a direct ranking factor in the traditional sense, but its effect on user engagement sends powerful signals to Google.

facts.fact: The page says the starting point for nearly all local schema is the LocalBusiness type.
facts.quote: The starting point for pretty much all local schema is the **LocalBusiness** type.

facts.fact: Vendor-cited studies claim that adding Local Schema can boost impressions in rich results by 17%.
facts.quote: Boost your impressions in rich results by **17%**.

facts.fact: Vendor-cited studies claim that adding Local Schema can increase click-through rates by up to 25-30%.
facts.quote: Increase click-through rates (CTR) by up to **25-30%**.

facts.fact: The vendor says unnamed industry benchmarks show businesses using LocalBusiness schema often see a 3-5 position improvement in local visibility.
facts.quote: Industry benchmarks show that businesses using LocalBusiness schema often see a **3-5 position improvement** in local visibility.

facts.fact: The vendor reports one unnamed café chain that added schema in 2023 dominated its local pack rankings within three months.
facts.quote: One real-world example saw a chain of cafés add schema in 2023 and completely dominate their local pack rankings in three months.

facts.fact: As of 2024, only 12.4% of all domains use structured data, according to the vendor's cited figure.
facts.quote: As of **2024**, only **12.4%** of all domains use structured data.

facts.fact: Google's Rich Results Test is described by the vendor as a free tool that checks JSON-LD code pasted in directly or a URL.
facts.quote: It’s a free, indispensable tool from Google.

facts.fact: The article says WordPress plugins such as Rank Math can generate local business schema from details the user enters.
facts.quote: WordPress plugins such as [Rank Math](https://rankmath.com/) can generate local business schema from the details you enter.

facts.fact: The article states the only rule for using multiple schema types on one page is that the added schema must be directly related to that page's content.
facts.quote: The only rule is to make sure the schema you add is directly related to the content on that page.
